text:
Asha: Quick UX note — model catalog compare view. Filter rail is noisy when 6+ facets active; hierarchy isn't scannable. Screenshot: https://re.d/shot123
Tom: I see that. Maybe we should auto-collapse low-usage groups and show top 3 values per group with a ‘more’ chevron. Keeps scanflow tight.
Priya: Curious if collapsing hurts discoverability for new users. Alternative: show active filters summary pill bar above the list (flattens visual weight).
Jorge: Also flagging performance badges — contrast on the light gray background is pretty weak. WCAG 4.5:1 recommendation — current tokens/cost badges fall below it.
Maya: Copy nit: 'p95 latency' is terse and confusing for non-eng readers. Suggest 'Latency (95th percentile)' or short 'Latency (95)'. Add tooltip with units (ms) and sample query.
Asha: Pinning UX: the small pin icon doesn't communicate scope (version vs model). Proposal: replace icon-only with 'Pin version' label on hover + persistent state badge when pinned. Add keyboard shortcut (P) hint in tooltip.
Tom: For keyboard/a11y: ensure pin control is focusable, in tab order, with aria-pressed and accessible name. Also expose pinned version via aria-live region on change.
Priya: Copy tweaks for CTAs: 'Compare' -> 'Compare selected' to reduce ambiguity; 'Select all' -> 'Select visible' because of paginated lists.
Maya: Slight layout ask: when in compact-compare mode, increase row-height by 4px to avoid label truncation; also allow wrap for long model names instead of ellipsis.
Asha: Microcopy alternatives for the performance badge tooltip: [1] "Latency (95th): 120 ms — lower is better" [2] "Response latency (95th percentile): 120 ms" Which is preferable?
Jorge: I prefer #2 — explicit and consistent with metric naming elsewhere.
Asha: Tiny CSS suggestion for focus ring so it meets contrast: .focus-ring { outline: 3px solid #1F6FEB; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px }
DesignBot: Reminder: please upload updated mock to Figma and tag @design-review by EOD Thursday. Link: https://figma.redwood/example
Tom: Accessibility testing note — keyboard-only flow for selecting filters -> pinning -> compare should be < 6 key presses. Can someone prototype the tab flow?
Priya: I can prototype a quick keyboard-flow tomorrow morning and post a short Loom.
Maya: Also we should add screen reader annc when compare results update: "Compare results updated — 3 models" via aria-live polite.
Asha: Great — action items: (1) Priya mock keyboard flow + Loom, (2) Design to update Figma labels + badge contrast, (3) Eng to add aria roles and focus ring; (4) copy to pick final microcopy (#2 for badge).
Jorge: :thumbsup:
Priya: Will do — ping me if you want to pair on the mock.
Asha: Thanks everyone — will bring this to Friday sync for sign-off.
